title: Why Don't Planets Fall Into the Sun? | Space Atlas
description: An orbit is a fall that keeps missing. Fire a cannonball at different speeds and see it crash, orbit, or escape — Newton's own thought experiment, interactive.
ogTitle: Why Don't Planets Fall Into the Sun?
ogDescription: Newton's cannonball, interactive: launch at different speeds and see the exact line between crashing, orbiting, and escaping.
jsonldName: Why Don't Planets Fall Into the Sun?
jsonldDescription: An interactive gravity simulation (Newton's cannonball) letting students launch a projectile at varying speeds to explore crashing, orbiting, and escape trajectories.
